consensus_summary: Symbolizes spiritual unfaithfulness to God, primarily through breaking covenant via idolatry, apostasy, and illicit political alliances with other nations.
book_summary: Symbolizes spiritual unfaithfulness, specifically breaking covenant with God to pursue other gods and kingdoms.
consensus_core_identification: Spiritual unfaithfulness / covenant-breaking (idolatry and foreign alliances)
book_core_identification: Spiritual unfaithfulness (breaking covenant to go after other gods and kingdoms)
boundary_disagreement: None. Both explicitly cover idolatry ('other gods') and political entanglement ('kingdoms'/'kings of the earth') under the umbrella of covenant unfaithfulness.
rationale: The book's definition is practically identical to the primary consensus understanding, viewing the symbol as spiritual unfaithfulness and covenant-breaking involving both idolatry and reliance on foreign powers.
